#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

class GTakeMetro {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber) {
        int n, m, s;
        long long t;
        std::cin >> n >> m >> s >> t;
        s -= 1;

        while (t % n != 0) {
            if (s < m) {
                s = (int)((s + t) % n);
            } else {
                s = (int)((s - t) % n);
                if (s < 0) s += n;
            }
            t--;
        }
        t /= n;
        std::vector<int> seen(n, -1);
        seen[s] = 0;
        int count = 0;

        while (t-- > 0) {
            count++;
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; --i) {
                if (s < m) {
                    s = (s + i) % n;
                } else {
                    s = (s - i + n) % n;
                }
            }
            if (seen[s] != -1) {
                t %= (count - seen[s]);
            }
            seen[s] = count;
        }

        std::cout << s + 1 << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    GTakeMetro solver;
    solver.solve(1);
    return 0;
}
